named-query.name: Expedicao.listarDetalhesExpedicao
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Expedicao e LEFT JOIN FETCH e.participacoes p LEFT JOIN FETCH p.pessoa pe WHERE e.id = :idExpedicao

named-query.name: Expedicao.listarColetasExpedicao
named-query.query: SELECT e FROM Expedicao e LEFT JOIN FETCH e.coletas c LEFT JOIN FETCH c.pesquisador LEFT JOIN FETCH c.setorPesquisa WHERE e.id = :idExpedicao
